title: Arkret Protocol Journey Wire Contracts
description: Closed wire carriers shared by bootstrap, Contact, stable Direct Conversation, participation, membership recovery, history, KeyPackage terminal handling and Sidecar staging.

contact_prepared_event_draft.description: Service-fixed canonical Event bytes without the holder proof. The client may only append the proof; after removing that proof the commit Event must equal these bytes, ID and digest exactly.

glare_concurrency_attestation.description: Source-signed evidence that the issuer had accepted both directional request receipts while neither request slot had yet been consumed by a normal response or rejection. Exactly one attestation from each pair member is required by the glare evidence bundle.

subject_id.description: Principal DID whose private Contact projection receives this fact.

recipient_service_id.description: Principal Server service DID that hosts subject_id and accepts this delivery.

peer_contact_authoritative_mirror_receip.description: Only an accepted or duplicate mirror receipt proves that the immutable signed Contact fact is durably mirrored. A deferred receipt is never authority for proof refresh or glare finalization.

result_digest.description: H('ak.peer-contact.control-result.v1',{request_digest,result_kind,glare_concurrency_attestation?,current_proof?}) over the exact closed successful result.

peer_contact_control_receipt.description: The recipient signs every field except signature. This receipt is only for proof_refresh or glare_finalize and cannot stand in for a signed Event mirror receipt.

peer_contact_event_submit_outcome.description: Only the five signed Contact Event request kinds use this branch. The receipt event coordinates and result_kind must match the submitted Event exactly. Request/response may return a current proof; accepted or duplicate scope/tombstone must return one; reject and deferred never do.

deployment_ceiling_core.description: Unsigned, digest-free deployment-ceiling transcript. Its canonical digest is computed over this exact core; neither the digest nor a completeness root appears inside the core.

deployment_ceiling_completeness_core.description: Closed, unsigned completeness transcript. completeness_root is computed over this exact core and therefore is intentionally absent here.

deployment_ceiling_fork_repair.description: The successor is the unique synthetic merge: predecessor_set equals the canonical-sorted fork head digests, successor.version is covered_through_version+1, and successor.predecessor_digest equals completeness_root. These cross-field equalities and the target-authority single-write CAS are mandatory evaluator checks.

ordinary_external_effect.description: Closed materialization FSM. Each branch has one exact plaintext schema and exact Event kind/cardinality/order. Destination preflight validates every request/authorization/prerequisite receipt digest before qDA; stages may advance only keypackage_claim -> founding_unit -> main_strand -> mls_epoch -> welcome_admission -> binding_finalize. No branch authorizes an arbitrary operation or a mixed-stage Event batch.

event_admission_authorization_projection.description: Mechanically derived closed projection of EventsSubmitFederationRequestBody. Events are sorted by event_id; every digest array is lower-case digest-byte sorted and deduplicated. Each evidence digest is H('ak.direct-conversation.evidence-object.v1', the exact closed evidence object). Empty evidence classes are represented by empty arrays, never omission. authorization_digest=H('ak.direct-conversation.external-authorization.v1', this exact projection).

direct_conversation_event_admission_jour.description: The destination validates the nested request against the stage's exact Event kind/cardinality/order and recomputes every effect_details digest from these complete receipt objects before issuing journal_validation_receipt.

direct_conversation_compensation_journal.description: Exactly one ak.member.state leave/remove compensation Event is allowed. Its nested membership_compensation_evidence must equal compensation_evidence byte-for-byte and bind the original founding delivery receipt and accepted join; destination preflight recomputes all digests before qDA.

authoritative_execution_bundle_delivery_.description: Only accepted or duplicate proves the q-committed effect reached its permanent semantic CAS. Deferred is durable transport only and never terminal cleanup evidence.

attempt_cleanup_manifest.description: Closed cleanup proof. effect_delivery_receipts is the exact ordered set of every externally delivered effect in the failed attempt. The evaluator derives the required compensation set from failed_stage and those receipts: every claimed package is terminal, and every accepted membership requiring compensation has an accepted/duplicate compensation Event delivery receipt. No host assertion can substitute for a missing authority receipt. manifest_digest=H('ak.direct-conversation.attempt-cleanup-manifest.v1', this exact object).

attempt_cleanup_certificate_bundle.description: Portable q-certified cleanup proof. value_core.effect must be attempt_cleanup and all manifest/value/qDA/qCOMMIT coordinates and digests must cross-match exactly.

attempt_advance_value.description: A successor committed in the old attempt log: outer attempt_sequence equals from_attempt, to_attempt equals from_attempt+1, predecessor_head_digest equals cleanup_effect_head_digest, and the exact q-certified cleanup bundle plus fresh peer claim request are carried in the journal.

host_transfer_journal_manifest.description: Closed complete journal inventory. Entries have consecutive journal_index values starting at 1 and form one predecessor-linked chain ending at completed_effect_head_digest; each coordinate resolves an exact immutable bundle. An empty array is valid only before the first effect and completed_effect_head_digest then equals genesis_head_digest. to_host_epoch equals from_host_epoch+1 and to_host_service_id must be in the signed domain policy eligible_hosts. manifest_digest=H('ak.direct-conversation.host-transfer-journal-manifest.v1', this exact object).

host_transfer_failover_certificate.description: Exactly quorum=2f+1 canonical distinct immutable replica votes over identical fields. The fresh read head must name from_host/from_epoch and the latest certified head, observed unavailability must satisfy the signed host epoch policy, and to_host must be policy-eligible. This replaces a missing old-host signature without trusting one coordinator.

host_transfer_authorization.description: Graceful transfer is authorized by the certified current host over the exact manifest digest. If that host is unavailable, the closed quorum failover certificate is the only alternative.

host_transfer_prepare_journal_plaintext.description: The current host signs exact {domain,manifest,manifest_digest,from_host_verification_method}. The target verifies and durably stores every exact manifest entry when the committed host_transfer_prepare bundle is delivered.

host_transfer_prepare_value.description: First committed step: outer expected/resulting host fence remains the current host and destination is to_host_service_id. Only an accepted/duplicate delivery receipt proves target acceptance.

host_transfer_finalize_journal_plaintext.description: The receipt destination equals manifest.to_host_service_id and its semantic commitment equals the exact preceding host_transfer_prepare effect for this manifest. Deferred receipts are forbidden.

authenticated_encrypted_journal.description: Closed single-recipient RFC 9180 base-mode HPKE envelope for EffectValueCore.destination. info is the UTF-8 domain string; AAD is RFC8785/JCS(aad_core). The destination decrypts and validates the exact plaintext before issuing journal_validation_receipt; qDA replicas verify that signed receipt and store the opaque envelope without learning the plaintext. The suite derives its nonce internally (single-shot sequence 0), so no nonce field exists. journal_root commits every scheme/key/enc/schema/AAD/ciphertext field.

operation_control_journal_aad_core.description: Exact AAD coordinates. journal_root, value_digest, ciphertext, enc and signatures are intentionally absent, avoiding a ciphertext/value self-reference.

journal_validation_core.description: Exact proposed value fields before a validation receipt exists. validation_core_digest=H('ak.direct-conversation.journal-validation-core.v1', this exact object).

journal_validation_request.description: Read-only destination preflight. It cannot execute an effect or reserve destination state. The destination verifies committed registry authorization, current host fence, envelope/root/AAD, decryptability, plaintext schema and every branch projection/digest before signing a receipt.

journal_validation_receipt.description: Destination signs every field except signature after successful read-only validation; issuer equals destination and recipient_key_ref equals the envelope key. expires_at-validated_at is at most 5 minutes. qDA must form before expiry; later expiry does not invalidate a qDA/qCOMMIT that incorporated the receipt while live. receipt_digest=H('ak.direct-conversation.journal-validation-receipt.v1', the exact signed receipt including signature).

effect_value_core.description: Immutable external-effect business value with a typed effect and complete host transition fence. It intentionally contains no view or certificate. value_digest is H('ak.direct-conversation.value.v1', this exact object).

payload_digest.description: H('ak.direct-conversation.effect-payload.v1', the exact authenticated plaintext payload executed by destination). Must equal authenticated_encrypted_journal.plaintext_digest and aad_core.payload_digest.

consensus_envelope.description: Closed phase XOR. PREPARE signs the digest of the exact PRE-PREPARE envelope; COMMIT signs the digest of the exact prepared certificate. Fields from another phase are rejected.

pre_prepare_digest.description: H('ak.direct-conversation.pre-prepare.v1', the exact signed PRE-PREPARE consensus_envelope including its signature).

prepared_certificate.description: The exact PRE-PREPARE is part of the certificate. Every PREPARE must carry its digest and otherwise match it on all instance, view, value and qDA coordinates.

certificate_digest.description: H('ak.direct-conversation.prepared-certificate.v1', semantic core containing every field except certificate_digest, pre_prepare and prepares).

qda_receipt.description: Each receipt repeats destination and all effect identity coordinates; evaluators require them to equal the referenced EffectValueCore byte-for-byte.

qda_certificate.description: qDA semantic certificate plus exact quorum witnesses. certificate_digest is stable across alternative valid witness subsets.

certificate_digest.description: H('ak.direct-conversation.qda-certificate.v1', semantic core containing every field except certificate_digest and receipts).
H('ak.direct-conversation.qcommit-certificate.v1', semantic core containing every field except certificate_digest and commits).

operation_control_domain_policy_core.description: Configured trust-domain-root policy snapshot. Evaluators require n=3f+1, quorum=2f+1 and canonical sorting of eligible sets. For a new pair-slot CAS, accepted_at must be within [issued_at,expires_at] and the root verification method must be valid at accepted_at and chain to the configured trust-domain anchor. Later policy expiry never invalidates an already accepted permanent registry; historical verification uses the root method state at accepted_at.

operation_control_domain_policy_statemen.description: The configured domain root signs the exact closed {core,policy_digest} object. The verification method in core must be controlled by core.domain_root_id and must chain to the verifier's trust-domain anchor.

pair_registry_core.description: Domain-root governed permanent pair slot. pair_slot_id=H('ak.direct-conversation.pair-slot.v1',{trust_domain_id,pair_key}) and pair_registry_id equals that stable slot id; registry_digest=H('ak.direct-conversation.pair-registry.v1',this exact core). replicas are exactly the first n canonical-sorted eligible policy replicas, initial_host_service_id is the first canonical-sorted eligible host, origin_coordinator=replicas[0], and proposer(view)=replicas[view mod n].

pair_registry_statement.description: Permanent single-write pair-slot CAS receipt. pair_registry_id equals core.pair_slot_id. The domain root signs every field except signature, including the one stable operation and its initial requester. domain_policy_statement and core coordinates must match; accepted_at must be inside the policy window. A second registry, operation or requester for the same pair_slot_id is permanently rejected. Policy expiry after accepted_at does not invalidate this historical receipt.

direct_conversation_materialization_gene.description: Domain-reserved immutable genesis returned before caller signing. It fixes every stable Realm/Strand/binding/MLS/event ID and the exact peer claim authorization draft. Later stage preparation fills content-dependent Event bytes, but may never change an ID or coordinate. materialization_genesis_digest=H('ak.direct-conversation.materialization-genesis.v1', this exact object).

operation_control_authorization_draft.description: Prepared caller-signed commit input only. It is not qDA/PBFT authority and cannot appear in an ExecutionBundle because it lacks the domain authorization commit receipt.

operation_control_authorization.description: Committed registry and requester authorization, self-contained apart from the configured trust-domain root anchor. requester_signature signs exact core only and its verification method/controller is resolved from requester_id. The domain-signed commit_receipt proves that the unexpired reservation handle and requester signature were accepted; a prepared draft without it is never qDA/PBFT authority. All statement/core/receipt pair, registry, stable operation and requester coordinates must match byte-for-byte.

operation_control_authorization_commit_r.description: The domain authority issues this only after consuming the live reservation handle, verifying requester_signature over the exact core, and matching the permanent pair statement. It signs every field except signature. Same exact commit replays this receipt; any different operation/requester/core for the slot conflicts permanently.

operation_control_proposal.description: Complete proposal material required before a replica may emit PREPARE. All value, qDA and journal coordinates must cross-match exactly. For view 0 new_view_certificate is forbidden; for view >0 it is required and its embedded proposal must be byte-identical to pre_prepare.

operation_control_qda_store.description: Replica must verify the live destination journal_validation_receipt, all public cross-matches and the committed authorization, then durably store these exact opaque journal bytes before issuing qDA. It recomputes journal_root and receipt digest; it does not need the destination's decryption key.

operation_control_message_submit_request.description: registry_digest must equal the embedded message registry coordinate. message_digest used by the receipt is H('ak.direct-conversation.operation-control-message.v1', the exact closed tagged message including inner signatures).

operation_control_message_receipt.description: The receiver signature covers every field except signature. duplicate is based on the registered semantic protocol slot/value rule; different carrier bytes for the same semantic vote are not equivocation.

operation_control_read_request.description: Signature covers every field except signature. read_request_digest=H('ak.direct-conversation.read-request.v1', that exact unsigned core). expires_at-issued_at MUST be <=60 seconds; receiver clock skew allowance is at most 5 seconds. Returned head.host_epoch must be >= minimum_host_epoch; when expected_host_service_id is present it must match exactly, while omission permits a certified successor host DID to be discovered after transfer.

operation_control_read_certificate.description: Evaluator requires quorum=2f+1, exactly quorum distinct immutable replicas in canonical order, and byte-identical request_digest and head in every receipt. observed_at must be inside the signed request window, every receipt expires no later than the request, consumer now must be within every expiry with at most 5 seconds skew, and observation age must be <=60 seconds. It proves only the fresh read and never authorizes an effect or attempt advance.

submitted_bundle_digest.description: H('ak.direct-conversation.execution-bundle-wire.v1', the complete bundle including witness arrays and signatures). It is an exact-recovery/audit digest, not the semantic CAS identity.

execution_bundle_delivery_receipt.description: For accepted or duplicate delivery, destination equals EffectValueCore.destination and host_service_id/host_epoch equal its resulting host fence. A host_transfer effect additionally requires destination=to_host_service_id; other effects preserve expected and resulting host exactly.

direct_conversation_prepared_event_draft.description: Service-built canonical Event bytes with proofs and reducer-managed fields absent. The participant adds only the required proof over event_digest and returns the exact resulting signed Event; any changed unsigned byte or digest is rejected.

direct_conversation_materialization_step.description: Current certified host signs the exact stage and ordered Event IDs/digests only after every returned signed Event is byte-identical to the prepared unsigned bytes except for allowed proofs. It is preparation evidence, not Event admission authority.

membership_compensation_action.description: Closed action selector. Subject and original join actor identities occur only once in membership_compensation_delegation_core; evaluators require leave for a self-authored join and remove for a delegated/admin-authored join.

membership_compensation_delegation_core.description: Unsigned and identifier-free canonical delegation core. delegation_digest is computed over this exact core; neither the outer delegation_id, digest nor signature is part of the core.

membership_compensation_executor_delegat.description: Content-addressed signed delegation. delegation_id MUST equal ak:membership-compensation-delegation:sha256:<hex>, where <hex> is exactly the suffix of delegation_digest=sha256:<hex> recomputed from the closed core.

sidecar_prepared_event_draft.description: Service-built canonical producer Event bytes with proofs and reducer-managed fields absent. The client MUST decode these exact bytes, add only a controller proof over event_digest, and return the resulting signed Event. The service MUST reject any other unsigned bytes or digest.

protected.description: Detached JWS protected header. Decoded JSON is closed to alg and kid; alg is from the CI allowlist and kid resolves under configured issuer trust roots.
